about_the_game:
Runewood: Hundred Nights is a roguelite survival card game set in the dark heart of the Sylvanian forest.

You are the legend spoken of in whispers: The one who survived a hundred nights in the wild Runewoods.


...Or was it you?

"Collect cards, cast powerful spells, and equip legendary artifacts to push your luck through the endless nights. Trade what you find for coins, or hoard your treasures for the battles ahead. Every decision might be your last."

After each night survived, you’ll choose your path. Will you challenge the machines of the Robotics Bay? Maybe face the ruthless warriors of the Tribal Grounds? Or wander deeper into the cursed Enchanted Forest where the woods themselves remember your name?

Whatever path you take, your survival writes the legend.

🌲 SURVIVAL

Hunt for cards, gather relics, and outlast the cold shadows of Runewood. There’s no comfort here. Only the forest, with your decissions.

⚙️ AUTOBATTLER

Plan your equipment, purchase cards, and let the battle unfold. Each day is a clash of strategy and chance. It's a dance of spells, claws, and steel you can only influence but never fully control.

💀 ROGUELITE

Death isn’t the end, it’s a lesson. Learn the habitants of each area, best card combinations, the power of the runes, which pull you deeper into the legend of the Hundred Nights. Learn, adapt, and maybe this time, the forest will remember your name.

From the Solo Game Developer: Jestercraft. The journey of “Shipping 24 Games in 24 Months.”

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 14.04 LTS
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1Gb Video Memory, capable of OpenGL 3.0+ support (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OSX 10.14+
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1Gb Video Memory, capable of OpenGL 3.0+ support (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
